resources.string: Tap any symbol for a plain-language meaning.
FOSS alarm-grade chart notes — not destiny advice.
at birth
in the sky now
Outlined live mark (same color as that planet): where %1$s is in the sky right now, drawn on the same wheel as your birth chart so you can see how today lines up with natal placements.
Ascendant (rising) · amber spoke

The Ascendant (ASC) is the zodiac degree that was rising on the eastern horizon at your birth time and place. On this wheel it is the amber spoke at the left. House 1 starts at your rising sign (whole-sign houses). Opposite it is the blue Descendant spoke. Needs an exact birth time.
Descendant (DSC) · blue spoke

The Descendant (DSC) is opposite the Ascendant — the western horizon point at birth, where the ecliptic was setting. The blue spoke marks it. House 7 starts there in whole-sign houses. In many charts it relates to one-to-one partnerships. Needs an exact birth time.
Midheaven (MC) · violet spoke

The Midheaven (MC, Medium Coeli) is the point of the ecliptic that was highest in the sky (“culminating”) at your birth. The violet spoke marks that direction. In many charts it relates to career and public life themes. It needs an exact birth time, like the Ascendant. Opposite it is the teal IC spoke (home/roots).
Imum Coeli (IC) · teal spoke

The Imum Coeli (IC, “bottom of the sky”) is opposite the Midheaven — the nadir of the MC/IC axis. The teal spoke marks it. In many charts it relates to home, roots, and private life. Needs an exact birth time.

☉ Sun: your natal solar position — the sign and degree of the Sun at birth. Often linked to vitality and core style. On this FOSS chart it is used for solar returns and Asc–Sun alarms.
☽ Moon: natal lunar position. Moves quickly; used for moon returns and emotional-cycle style alarms on this app.
☿ Mercury: natal Mercury — communication and mind themes in traditional astrology. Also used for Mercury station alarms.
♀ Venus: natal Venus — values, attraction, and aesthetics in traditional chart reading.
♂ Mars: natal Mars — drive and assertiveness themes in traditional chart reading.
♃ Jupiter: natal Jupiter — growth and expansion themes. Drawn quieter than the personal planets on this wheel.
♄ Saturn: natal Saturn — structure, limits, and time themes. Drawn quieter than the personal planets.
♅ Uranus: natal Uranus — change and originality themes in modern astrology. Outer planet; quieter on this wheel.
♆ Neptune: natal Neptune — imagination and dissolution themes in modern astrology. Outer planet; quieter on this wheel.
♈ Aries (0°–30°): first fire sign of the tropical zodiac.
♉ Taurus (30°–60°): earth sign following Aries.
♊ Gemini (60°–90°): air sign of the third 30° sector.
♋ Cancer (90°–120°): water sign; summer solstice sector in the northern tropical year.
♌ Leo (120°–150°): fire sign following Cancer.
♍ Virgo (150°–180°): earth sign before the autumn equinox sector.
♎ Libra (180°–210°): air sign; starts at the September equinox longitude.
♏ Scorpio (210°–240°): water sign following Libra.
♐ Sagittarius (240°–270°): fire sign before Capricorn.
♑ Capricorn (270°–300°): earth sign; December solstice sector.
♒ Aquarius (300°–330°): air sign following Capricorn.
♓ Pisces (330°–360°): water sign ending the tropical year.
House %1$d
House 1 (whole-sign): your rising sign — the “you / appearance” sector in traditional house lore. Starts at the Ascendant’s sign.
House 2: resources and belongings themes in traditional house lore.
House 3: siblings, short trips, and everyday mind themes.
House 4: home, roots, and private base themes.
House 5: creativity, pleasure, and children themes.
House 6: work routines and health-maintenance themes.
House 7: partnerships and one-to-one bonds.
House 8: shared resources and deeper transitions.
House 9: belief, study, and long-range travel themes.
House 10: public life and career themes (near the Midheaven in many systems).
House 11: friends, groups, and future aims.
House 12: solitude, rest, and unseen support themes.
